thread:
kai: deploy-bot fired an autorevert recommendation for text-gen-service v5.2.0 -> v5.1.7. drop in throughput and service timeouts on canary. change window ends 06:00 UTC. can someone hold/approve?
deploy-bot: ALERT: canary text-gen-service error_rate 0.6% -> 2.8%, tail timeouts increased. suggested rollback to v5.1.7. evidence URL: https://telemetry.redwood/canary/3423
lina: thanks, checking. is this our streaming change or the new kernel selector?
kai: initial traces show more TCP retries on host gpu-gen-09; runtime logs include a new kernel-path decision for long-context that wasn't exercised before.
darryl: if it's infra transient we could wait a few minutes, but deploy-bot hit threshold. since we have a scheduled data migration for EU Dedicated at 07:00, i'd prefer manual decision.
cs-ops: heads-up: two enterprise customers have traffic routed through this canary slice; recommend manual hold and a short customer blurb if we rollback.
legal: cc'ing legal for any SLA concerns. please keep us updated.
oncall-ops: change window 04:00-06:00 UTC. canary slice is 15%. auto-rollback would affect small percent but do we want to pin versions for dedicated lanes?
kai: i'd like to suppress auto-rollback for 5m while we confirm. Lina can you run a targeted smoke and check kvcache hit-rate?
lina: running smoke now: `curl -s https://textgen.int/canary/health | jq .p50,.p95,.error_rate`
lina: smoke: p50 110ms p95 980ms error 2.5% on canary. kvcache hit-rate dropped 12% vs baseline.
darryl: that points to cache warming/regression. autorevert might fix but will lose telemetry for root cause. Suggest manual rollback with GC of cache after revert.
kai: request manual approval: we'll pin v5.1.7 for canary and run `release rollback --svc text-gen-service --to v5.1.7 --slice 15 --reason "canary tail regressions"`
oncall-ops: assigning @darryl to execute revert and @lina to monitor. please follow rollback playbook (drain -> revert -> validate -> re-enable autoscale).
darryl: executing in 1m. disabling ramp: `infractl routing set textgen-canary --ramp false`
darryl: revert command: ```release rollback --svc text-gen-service --to v5.1.7 --strategy rolling --slice 15 --notes "manual approve: cache hit-rate drop"```
deploy-bot: ACTION: rollback initiated by darryl. progress: 10% -> 45% -> 90%
lina: after 50% rolled back p95 down to 140ms, errors 0.7%. kvcache hit-rate climbing.
cs-ops: drafting customer blurb: "We detected a transient degradation in a canary release and rolled back to the previous version. No customer data affected. We will follow up with an engineering update." sending to CSMs now.
legal: no immediate SLA impact. please include timeline in incident note.
darryl: rollback complete. re-enabling ramp: `infractl routing set textgen-canary --ramp true` and autoscale restored.
lina: running post-rollback validation suite now. all checks green except one long-tail trace we captured. saving traces for RCA.
kai: great. Lina and I will own RCA, will look at kernel selector traces and kvcache warm-up heuristics. target initial draft in next 6 hours.
oncall-ops: monitoring 2h with tightened p95 alert. temporary rule created: canary p95 threshold = 400ms.
darryl: closing ops loop and leaving note in release board. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
